integrity: The graph decomposition is derived directly from the generalized dicyclic multiplication law and a complete centralizer calculation. The cograph and chordal consequences are also checked against the published AC-group criterion. Bounded finite computation is used only as an independent replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to nonabelian generalized dicyclic groups with finite abelian kernel and inversion action.
The commuting graph recovers the kernel order and the size of its 2-torsion subgroup, not the full abelian-kernel isomorphism type.
An equivalent elementary centralizer calculation could exist under alternate terminology or in unindexed literature.
title: Commuting graphs of generalized dicyclic groups are controlled by 2-torsion
